text: The system should respond quickly to user queries.
The user interface shall be user-friendly.
The application shall load pages fast on mobile devices.
The system shall provide adequate security for stored payment data.
Search results shall be returned in a reasonable amount of time.
The software shall be easy to maintain.
The checkout flow shall be seamless for returning customers.
The system shall handle peak load efficiently.
Error messages shall be clear and helpful.
The dashboard shall display data in a timely manner.
The system should be robust.
The reporting module must be reliable.
The application should support offline mode.
The system might send an email notification when an order ships.
Reports shall be generated for all borrowed books.
Passwords must be encrypted.
Invalid orders shall be rejected.
Audit logs shall be retained for seven years.
The data will be validated before submission.
Notifications shall be sent when stock runs low.
The system shall support many concurrent users.
The system shall store several years of transaction history.
Users can upload multiple files at once.
The platform shall support various payment methods.
The system shall respond to most requests within 2 seconds.
The librarian shall be able to export data in formats such as PDF, etc.
The system shall send alerts via email, SMS, and so on.
Patient records shall be updated as needed.
The app shall support browsers including Chrome, Firefox, etc.
The admin shall configure permissions as appropriate.
The system shall send the invoice to the customer and it shall log the transaction.
When the user uploads a document to the folder, it shall be scanned for viruses.
The manager shall review the report from the analyst before he submits it to the client.
The module reads data from the sensor and sends it to the controller, which then updates it.
The server shall notify the client when it is overloaded.
The system shall bank the daily transactions at midnight.
The application shall refresh the chart every minute.
The portal shall register new members.
Admins and users with access can edit the document.
The system shall display the names of all employees and managers who work in Berlin.
The system shall allow editing of orders by customers with discounts.
The report shall list customers who bought products from Europe or Asia and Africa.
If the user is an admin or a manager and has approval, the system shall allow deletion.
The system shall refund the customer if the item is damaged or late and the customer has a receipt.
The system shall send a reminder to users who have not logged in, unless they opted out and have a premium plan.
The discount shall apply when the order total is over $100 and under $50.
Data shall be retained according to the SLA.
The system shall comply with the standard security policy.
Users in the premium tier shall have priority access.
The module shall apply the usual discount rules.
The system shall lock a member account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
The system shall return search results within 2 seconds for at least 95% of queries under a load of 500 concurrent users.
The system shall encrypt all stored passwords using bcrypt with a cost factor of at least 12.
The video player shall provide a fast-forward button that skips 10 seconds.
The mobile application shall run on Android 12 and later.
The system shall send a confirmation email to the customer within 60 seconds of order placement.
The administrator shall be able to disable a user account from the user management page.
The system shall retain audit logs for 7 years.
The API shall return HTTP status 404 when the requested resource does not exist.
The system shall display the total price including 20% VAT on the checkout page.
The database shall be backed up every day at 02:00 UTC.
Users shall be able to reset their password using a link emailed to their registered address, valid for 30 minutes.
The system shall support CSV and PDF export of the monthly sales report.
The login page shall require a username and a password of at least 12 characters.
The system shall log each failed payment attempt with timestamp, user ID and error code.
The website shall render correctly in the latest two major versions of Chrome, Firefox and Safari.
The system shall allow a librarian to renew a loan up to 3 times per book.
The system shall terminate user sessions after 15 minutes of inactivity.
The thermostat shall switch on the heater when the room temperature falls below 18 °C.
The system shall display the error message "Invalid credentials" when the login fails.
The system shall store uploaded files up to 25 MB each.
The payment module shall process refunds within 5 business days.
The nurse shall be able to view a patient's allergy list within 2 seconds of opening the record.
The system shall generate a borrowing report listing every book borrowed during the selected date range.
The application shall support English, Spanish and German.
The system shall send an SMS to the driver when the delivery is assigned.
The system shall prevent the booking of a room already reserved for the same time slot.
The web server shall handle at least 1,000 requests per second with a CPU utilization below 70%.
The system shall require two-factor authentication for all administrator accounts.
The system shall display the stock quantity on the product page and update it within 5 seconds of a change.
The customer shall be able to cancel an order before it is shipped.
The system shall use TLS 1.2 or higher for all external connections.
The mobile app shall request location permission only when the user opens the map screen.
The system shall assign each new ticket a unique 8-digit identifier.
The system shall notify the manager by email when an expense above $1,000 is submitted.
The scheduler shall run the cleanup job every Sunday at 03:00 server time.
The system shall allow users to filter orders by status, date range and customer name.
The system shall round all monetary amounts to two decimal places.
The user shall be able to undo the last 20 actions in the editor.
The system shall display the user's name in the page header after login.
The kiosk shall print a receipt within 3 seconds after payment is confirmed.
The system shall reject any file upload with an extension other than .pdf, .png or .jpg.
The system shall compute the late fee as $0.50 per day per overdue book, up to a maximum of $10.
The inventory service shall publish a "StockLow" event when quantity falls below the reorder threshold stored for the product.
The system shall be available 99.9% of the time, measured monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance.
The patient portal shall display lab results within 1 hour of their release by the laboratory.
The system shall record the date and time of each login in UTC.
Admin users shall be able to assign one role to each user account.
The elevator controller shall open the doors within 2 seconds of reaching the requested floor.
The system shall display a progress bar during file uploads.
